text:
Maya Kaur: Heads-up — WillowRetail (NM: account) showing a steep drop in API calls and embeddings over last 14 days. Signals flag: competitor SignalAI ran a trial last week and procurement reached out to them.

Jonah Li: saw that in the renewal tracker. Do we have a primary use-case change? any new contact?

Maya Kaur: Primary POC (Elena Torres) changed role last month; new PM (Avi) onboarded. Usage: tokens/day 14d avg -> 2.6k (previously ~14k). Also embeddings requests down 78%.

Priya Patel: Can you paste the dashboard snapshot? curious if it's traffic shape or auth errors.

Maya Kaur: Dashboard excerpt:
```
last_30d_calls: 3,200
last_14d_avg_tokens/day: 2,600
prev_30d_avg_tokens/day: 14,100
embeddings_last_14d: 420 (was 1,900)
error_rate_14d: 0.2%
```

Maya Kaur: No spike in errors. Looks like feature usage decline, not platform failure.

Jonah Li: I had a touchpoint with procurement — they asked about SignalAI's offline bundle price. Sounds like cost + feature fit.

Tom Reynolds: @Maya @Jonah let's run playbook: (1) quick health check call with new PM, (2) propose targeted enablement + cost-optimization plan, (3) prepare fallback SLA offer if they push hard.

Maya Kaur: I'll request a call. Proposed times: Tue/Wed this week. draft note to Elena/Avi:
"Hi Avi/Elena — quick 30m to sync on current usage and roadmap? We see lower activity and want to surface quick wins (cost, model selection, batching) before renewal."

Priya Patel: I can join and bring a small plan: batching + cache + quantization options that could cut unit cost 30-50% for their query patterns.

Jonah Li: I'll ready competitive comparison slide (SignalAI vs Redwood: offline bundling, throughput, support). Can we get their trial report from last week? procurement might have it.

Maya Kaur: Opening internal ticket CS-4759 to track actions and attachments. Will tag notes in the account playbook.

alerts-bot: new account-insight: WillowRetail flagged for 'usage_drop + competitor_contact' (score 8/10)

Tom Reynolds: Good. After call, prioritize a short pilot proposal (2-week targeted pilot) to re-engage. If they resist, escalate to enterprise AE for pricing discussion.

Maya Kaur: Scheduling now. Thanks team :thumbsup:

Jonah Li: +1, ping me when scheduled and I'll prep slide deck.

Priya Patel: I'll prepare a small demo of caching and batching impact on their sample corpus.

Maya Kaur: I'll include expected delta numbers in the calendar invite. End.
